title: Moab Rebels

questions.question: Who became king of Israel in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:1 (ESV): "...Jehoram the son of Ahab became king over Israel in Samaria..."

questions.question: Who rebelled against the king of Israel after Ahab died?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:5 (ESV): "But when Ahab died, the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel."

questions.question: Which kings joined Jehoram to fight Moab?
options: Jehoshaphat king of Judah and the king of Edom
questions.correctAnswer: Jehoshaphat king of Judah and the king of Edom
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:9 (ESV): "So the king of Israel went with the king of Judah and the king of Edom..."

questions.question: What problem did the armies face in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:9 (ESV): "...And there was no water for the army or for the animals that followed them."

questions.question: What did Mesha king of Moab do when he saw the battle was going against him?
options: He offered his oldest son as a burnt offering
questions.correctAnswer: He offered his oldest son as a burnt offering
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:27 (ESV): "Then he took his oldest son... and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall..."

questions.question: Who did Jehoshaphat ask for to inquire of the Lord?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:11 (ESV): "But Jehoshaphat said, 'Is there no prophet of the LORD here...?'. .. Elisha the son of Shaphat is here..."

questions.question: Why did Elisha agree to help?
options: For the sake of Jehoshaphat king of Judah
questions.correctAnswer: For the sake of Jehoshaphat king of Judah
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:14 (ESV): "...Were it not that I have regard for Jehoshaphat king of Judah, I would neither look at you nor see you."

questions.question: What did Elisha ask for before prophesying?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:15 (ESV): "But now bring me a musician. And when the musician played, the hand of the LORD came upon him."

questions.question: What did Elisha prophesy would happen?
options: Make this valley full of pools... ye shall not see wind or rain, yet that valley shall be filled with water
questions.correctAnswer: Make this valley full of pools... ye shall not see wind or rain, yet that valley shall be filled with water
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:16-17 (ESV): "...Make this valley full of pools... You shall not see wind or rain, but that valley shall be filled with water..."

questions.question: Why did the Moabites think the water was blood?
options: The sun shone on the water and it looked red
questions.correctAnswer: The sun shone on the water and it looked red
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:22 (ESV): "...the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water opposite them as red as blood."

questions.question: What tribute did Mesha used to pay?
options: 100,000 lambs and the wool of 100,000 rams
questions.correctAnswer: 100,000 lambs and the wool of 100,000 rams
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:4 (ESV): "...he used to pay the king of Israel 100,000 lambs and the wool of 100,000 rams."

questions.question: Which way did they go to attack Moab?
options: By the way of the wilderness of Edom
questions.correctAnswer: By the way of the wilderness of Edom
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:8 (ESV): "...By the way of the wilderness of Edom."

questions.question: What did Elisha call Jehoram?
options: Go to the prophets of your father and mother
questions.correctAnswer: Go to the prophets of your father and mother
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:13 (ESV):And Elisha said to the king of Israel, '...Go to the prophets of your father and to the prophets of your mother.'"

questions.question: What cities were the Israelites to destroy?
options: Every fortified city and every choice city
questions.correctAnswer: Every fortified city and every choice city
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:19 (ESV): "And you shall attack every fortified city and every choice city..."

questions.question: What town was left with only its stones?
questions.explanation: 2 Kings 3:25 (ESV): "...until only in Kir-hareseth left they the stones thereof..."

key_verse_text: And this is a light thing in the sight of the LORD. He will also give the Moabites into your hand. (ESV)
